common.fixtureBanner: This screen is built from example data, not collected data. Do not rely on it.

home.title: Who are you travelling with?
home.intro: What you choose here changes the verdicts on the screens that follow. Choosing nothing is fine.
howTo: Pick the conditions of the people travelling with you. Several at once is fine.
In the place list, read the verdict and what still needs checking.
On a detail page, expand “How this score was calculated” to see the whole basis of the verdict.
home.cognitiveOption: Travelling with a child who finds new places hard
home.cognitiveHint: Available when you are travelling with a stroller.
home.minRuleTitle: The verdict follows whoever needs the most support
home.minRule: If you choose more than one condition, the calculation follows the one this place serves worst. That keeps an item that is decisive for one person from being hidden behind another person’s score.
home.statNote: A blank field means “not known yet”, never “not available”. This service keeps those two apart everywhere.

places.title: Baekje Historic Areas in Gongju and Buyeo
places.sortNote: Ordered: you can visit, check first, not enough information, consider another place. “Not enough information” sits above “Consider another place” because a place we do not know about ranks above one we know you cannot enter.
places.noVerdict: We do not know {unknown} of the {total} items that matter for {persona}
places.mapUnavailable: A map is not part of this release. Everything works from the list above.

place.scoreHiddenReason: Not enough information to judge — check on site
place.confidenceHint: A different number from the score: it shows how much information the verdict is based on.
place.openCalc: See how this score was calculated
place.roundingNote: Displayed values are rounded to three decimals. The score is computed before rounding, so the sum of the rows and the A total can differ in the last digit.
place.freshnessNote: An old check date means we are less sure, not that the place is worse — so it does not reduce the score.
place.whyCautionUnknown: Required items we do not know: {items}
place.whyCautionCoverage: Only {known} of the {total} items the verdict needs are known
place.axisAllUnknown: All {count} items on the {axis} axis are unknown
place.etcNotesHint: Source text we could not split into individual accessibility items. It does not enter the score.
place.reportsDisclaimer: Visitors write these, and the operator has not checked them. They are separate from the items above and do not affect the suitability score.
place.alternativesHint: Places with a better verdict under the same conditions.
place.safetyNote: The emergency-department and defibrillator distances on the Situation axis are calculated from this list. They are straight-line distances, not walking distances — at the hilltop fortresses the walk is considerably longer. Where a coordinate could not be confirmed, no distance is calculated and the item stays unknown.
place.crowdRate: Expected crowds {value} — not a score out of 100
place.noPhotos: No photographs have been collected for this place yet.
place.reportsFailed: Reports could not be loaded. That does not mean there are none — it means we cannot check right now.
place.reportFlagFailed: Could not flag this report. Try again in a moment.
place.coverageBasis: items you need that we have checked
place.confidenceBasis: data confidence — coverage and check dates together
place.whyCautionScore: Everything this verdict rests on is checked, but the fit score is {score}, below the 75 needed for “You can visit”.

gapReport.title: Barrier-free information gap report, Gongju and Buyeo
gapReport.asOf: As of {date} · {places} places · KTO barrier-free travel items
gapReport.fillCaption: The three columns add up to that place’s item count.
gapReport.fillNote: The two columns stay apart because merging them would make the municipality look as though it had improved something every time we fill a cell ourselves. Only the “Confirmed by KTO” column going up means the municipality itself has moved.
gapReport.notRegistered: {place} — the place itself is not registered. It has to be registered before any item can be filled in.
gapReport.priorityCaption: Only unknown and unavailable items appear.

causeLegend.unknown: Cause not established — the cell is blank. Checking it is the first task.
causeLegend.operator: Not entered by the operator — confirmed with the responsible office.
causeLegend.intrinsic: Structural constraint — hard to install without altering the protected site.

gapReport.causeNote: We write a cause only where we know it. An empty response is never read as “nobody filled it in”. The point is that the officer who receives this report has nothing to correct in its first line.
gapReport.visitorsDelay: The source data arrives about a month late, so the most recent weeks have no figure yet.
gapReport.visitorsUnavailable: The visitor trend has not been collected yet.
gapReport.empty: Nothing to list as an improvement priority.
gapReport.priorityShown: The {perPlace} most urgent items at each place — {shown} rows in all. The full {total} are in the CSV below.
